description_en: Queries the auto-renewal status of a Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAcceleratorAutoRenewAttribute接口查询全球加速实例的自动续费状态
kebab_example: aliyun ga describe-accelerator-auto-renew-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAcceleratorAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the GA instance

AutoRenew.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values:

true
false
AutoRenew.description_zh:
是否开启了自动续费。取值：

true：是。

false：否

RenewalStatus.description_en:
Indicates how the GA instance is renewed. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: The GA instance is automatically renewed.
Normal: You must manually renew the GA instance.
NotRenewal: The GA instance is not renewed after it expires. The system sends only a non-renewal reminder three days before the expiration date. The system no longer sends notifications to remind you to renew the GA instance
RenewalStatus.description_zh:
全球加速实例的自动续费状态。取值：

AutoRenewal：设置为自动续费。

Normal：手动续费。

NotRenewal：不再续费，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒
